A role_assignment that was merely PROPOSED (one signature short of T-0605's required second, distinct approval) would grant FULL tenant-owner or delegable mgmt_object:* admin authority through this path. Status: real but DORMANT — T-0764's exhaustive 58-file audit of every live role_assignment INSERT in src/+ci/checks/db/ found zero rows with proposed_by set outside 6 deliberate dual-control test fixtures, none of which target tenant-owner or feed these two resolvers. Proven a structural no-op for every current row: the disjunct evaluates to TRUE whenever proposed_by IS NULL (today's only live shape), so the ACTIVE genesis-owner/admin path is provably unaffected — both by T-0764's static audit and by a new live-Postgres probe seeding routine/semi-confirmed/dual-confirmed shapes side by side. loadAdminContext step 3 (the mgmt_object:* grant query) was found to carry NO confirmed_by/confirmed2_by predicate at all on the grant row itself — a separate, real-looking gap on a different axis (T-0397 grant-row dual-control, not T-0605 assignment-row dual-control) — deliberately NOT fixed here (out of scope, flagged in spec.md §6, own follow-up task recommended) per D-064 anti-scope-creep discipline.
